_field_help.page_types: Per-page label. Non-fillable values (instructions|cover|terms|signature_only|blank) make every prediction on that page a false positive.
_field_help.type: One of: text, multiline, date, comb, checkbox, checkbox_group, radio_group, signature, table_cell.
_field_help.bbox: Page-local FRACTIONS (0..1), top-left origin: {x, y, width, height}. Same convention as the pipeline's mappings.json bbox.
_field_help.cell_count: For comb / checkbox_group / radio_group, the number of logical cells/options. >1 marks the widget as a 'group' for fragmentation scoring.
_field_help.repeat_group_id: Same id on each copy of a repeated section (e.g. 'applicant'), so repeated-section recall can be measured.
_field_help.fillable: false for a labelled region that should NOT become a widget (e.g. a printed example).
